answer: Let \(G\) be the attestation graph, with trust measured by bounded-length random-walk mass from independently trusted nodes outside a Sybil set \(S\). Its conductance, \(\Phi(S)=|\partial S|/\mathrm{vol}(S)\), measures the sparse external cut; low conductance limits walk flow into \(S\). If voting weight is capped by that incoming mass, the cluster’s aggregate weight is bounded accordingly. An ivory and violet diagram with a narrow inlet can illustrate this bottleneck.
